**Junior Engineer - IT**
located in
**Sriperumbudur**
**What a typical day looks like:**

* Responsible for supporting, maintaining, and enhancing ERP applications that facilitate manufacturing, supply chain, planning, procurement, inventory, and finance operations.
* Works closely with Business Users, Production, Planning, Finance, and IT teams to ensure smooth ERP operations and continuous process improvements.

**ERP Application Support**

* Manufacturing
* Planning
* Procurement
* Inventory/Warehouse Management
* Sales Order Management
* Finance
* Master Data Management
* Shop Floor Integration

* Knowledge of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
* Understanding of production planning, procurement, warehousing, and inventory management.
* Experience in report development and data analysis.
* Knowledge of ERP integrations and interfaces.
* Basic understanding of ERP concepts and business processes.
* Knowledge of Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Inventory, or Finance operations.
* SQL query and database fundamentals.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams
* Flexible to work in shifts

title: Customer Support Solutions Lead Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Join the Grid Automation Customer Support Center of Excellence (CoE) and play a key role in shaping the future of customer support and technical solutions across our global Grid Automation business.
  
  
As a Customer Support Solutions Lead Engineer, you will act as a global technical expert supporting regional teams in the design, promotion, delivery, and lifecycle management of advanced Grid Automation solutions across Transmission, Distribution, Generation, and Industry applications.
  
  
You will be at the intersection of technology, customers, engineering, product management, and operations, helping regional teams solve complex technical challenges while developing innovative and differentiated solutions that deliver measurable value to our customers.
  
  
The role combines hands-on technical expertise, solution architecture, customer engagement, technical leadership, and knowledge sharing. You will work closely with regional engineering teams, Global Supply Chain, Quality, Product Management, R&D, Sales, Tendering, and Operations to resolve critical customer issues and continuously improve our customer support offering.
  
  
This is an opportunity to become a global technical reference for Grid Automation solutions, influence engineering standards and best practices, and contribute to the development of the next generation of digital and automated power networks.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Complex Grid Automation Solutions**
Support GA regional teams in the development and execution of innovative and technically challenging customer projects.
  
  

* Design and review solutions for substation control, protection, monitoring, and automation.
* Assess customer requirements and determine the suitability of standard GA solutions, identifying where customization or specific development may be required.
* Develop innovative technical solutions that balance performance, flexibility, reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, and total cost of ownership.
* Define system engineering strategies covering:

+ System and network architecture
+ Interfaces with primary equipment
+ IED and SCADA communications
+ Physical and logical communication networks
+ Network redundancy and system availability
+ Protection and control functions
+ Data modeling and engineering databases
+ Maintenance and lifecycle management

**Essential**
Qualifications & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or a related field.
* Strong experience leading the technical execution of complex Grid Automation, Substation Automation, Protection & Control, or Power System projects.
* Solid knowledge of power system and substation control and protection applications across Transmission, Distribution, Generation, and/or Industry.
* Strong experience in:

+ Protection and control system design
+ System architecture
+ Engineering and validation
+ Commissioning and troubleshooting
+ Customer technical support
+ Communication networks and protocols

* Good knowledge of industrial and power-system communication technologies, including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-103, Modbus, DNP3, TCP/IP, and Ethernet.DS Agile digital control system
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify, explain, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Customer-oriented mindset with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects and priorities under demanding timelines.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and collaborate effectively with international stakeholders.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity, functional safety, FMEA/HAZOP, reliability, and quality metrics such as MTBF.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 25% of the time.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in digital substations and IEC 61850 engineering.
* Experience with Grid Automation or substation automation platforms such as DS Agile and associated products.
* Demonstrated experience in technical mentoring, coaching, and knowledge transfer.
* Proven ability to influence and inspire technical teams without direct hierarchical responsibility.
* Strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on technical execution.
* Experience with Lean / Six Sigma methodologies.
* Experience working in a global, multicultural engineering organization.

**The Profile We Are Looking For**
We are looking for a
**technically strong and customer-oriented engineering leader**
who enjoys solving complex problems, working across organizational boundaries, and sharing knowledge with others.
  
  
You are comfortable moving from
**high-level system architecture to detailed technical troubleshooting**
, from customer discussions to engineering design reviews, and from solving an individual project issue to turning the experience into a global best practice.
  
  
If you are passionate about
**Grid Automation, digital substations, power systems, and technical innovation**
, and want to have a global impact beyond individual projects, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the future of our business and our customers.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Fault Management L2 Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
As a 5G SA Core-Ericsson EPC Specialist at Nokia, you will play a critical role in fault management and configuration of 5G SA Core networks. Collaborating closely with project teams, you will oversee design reviews and network integration activities while troubleshooting and handling customer issues. Your technical expertise in Ericsson Packet Core, cloud-native architecture, and E2E call flows will guide the team through complex configurations and improvements. By analysing feedback and coordinating with various stakeholders, you will help maintain optimal service quality and contribute to the advancement of innovative 5G solutions.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Fault management/configuration of 5G SA Core Network.
* Coordination with Project teams for HLD/LLD/TOL/Design reviews
* Hand in Hand coordination with project for network integration activities
* Handle the Trouble ticket/CR within SLA
* Customer Issue handling and ensuring the end customer services are maintained
* MOP/WI preparation for the activities and new learnings
* Prepare, implement and verify the configuration and integration of a Node / System
* Coordinating with care team for finding and analysing the RCAs
* Guiding team members to execute complex & critical configuration changes
* Tracking of issues related to tools and timely escalation as per pre-defined matrix
* Attending governance call with region and internal teams. Also responsible for analysing and implementation of feedback from customers.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must-Have:
  
  

* Require a bachelor's or master's degree in a related field
* Typically, a minimum of 5 to 8 years experience in the Ericsson Packet Core Domain, specifically with 5G Core Nodes (AMF, SMF, UPF, NRF) and LTE Nodes (MME, SGW/PGW).
* Hands-on experience with E2E call flows for 5G, LTE, and volte systems
* Strong understanding of LTE and 5G EPC/5G Core Architecture Interfaces and Protocols
* Proficiency in Cloud Native Architecture, including Microservices, Kubernetes, and Containers
* Ability to prepare, implement, and verify configurations and integrations of network nodes

Nice-To-Have:
  
  

* Experience with IMS architecture and associated nodes
* Familiarity with Service-Based Architecture concepts and Network Slicing
* Knowledge of trouble ticketing systems and SLA management
* Experience in governance calls and feedback detailed with stakeholders
* Ability to guide team members through complex configuration changes
